title: SimpleTabList
description: Full LuckPerms support and easy to use.
body:
Simple TabList is a lightweight Paper plugin for customizing your server's tablist with minimal setup.

**Features**
- LuckPerms prefix/suffix integration
- Flexible player sorting
- Custom headers & footers (world-specific)
- Animations for header, footer & sidebar
- Scoreboard/sidebar with toggle support
- Hex & RGB color support
- PlaceholderAPI support

**Dependencies**
- LuckPerms
- PlaceholderAPI

**Commands**

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/stl-reload` | `stl.reload` | Reload config |
| `/sidebar` | `stl.sidebar.toggle` | Toggle sidebar |

**Notes**
- Continuous tablist refresh is disabled by default for performance — enable it in the config with a custom interval
- Always back up your config before updating
